result.instructions: Tools for MyParcel, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my shipments are still pending, and which were handed to the carrier today?"; "Show the track and trace history for shipment 12345."; "Create a PostNL shipment for this recipient in Amsterdam and return the new shipment id.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MyParcel data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run myparcel_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run myparcel_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run myparcel_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. myparcel_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: myparcel_list_shipments
tools.title: List shipments
tools.description: List the account's shipments, newest first, with status, recipient and carrier. Filter by a text query or a status id. MyParcel API: GET /shipments.

q.description: Search text (for example a recipient name).

tools.name: myparcel_get_shipments
tools.title: Get shipments
tools.description: Get one or more shipments by id, including options, recipient, status and label links. MyParcel API: GET /shipments/{ids}.

ids.description: Shipment ids from myparcel_list_shipments or myparcel_create_shipments.

tools.name: myparcel_get_tracktraces
tools.title: Get track and trace
tools.description: Get the track and trace events for one or more shipments (carrier scan history and status). MyParcel API: GET /tracktraces/{ids}.

ids.description: Shipment ids from myparcel_list_shipments or myparcel_create_shipments.

extra_info.description: Optional extra data, for example delivery_moment.

tools.name: myparcel_list_fulfilment_orders
tools.title: List fulfilment orders
tools.description: List fulfilment orders (orders the account asked MyParcel to pick and ship), filtered by status. MyParcel API: GET /fulfilment/orders.

status.description: Status filter, separated by ';' (for example open;partially_processed).

tools.name: myparcel_get_fulfilment_order
tools.title: Get a fulfilment order
tools.description: Get one fulfilment order by its UUID, including its lines and status. MyParcel API: GET /fulfilment/orders/{identifier}.

tools.name: myparcel_get_delivery_options
tools.title: Get delivery options
tools.description: Get the delivery options (dates, delivery types, cut-off times) for one address and carrier, for a checkout. MyParcel API: GET /delivery_options (version 2.0).

platform.description: myparcel for NL, belgie for BE.

carrier.description: Carrier name, for example postnl or bpost.

cc.description: ISO country code, e.g. nl or be.

tools.name: myparcel_list_pickup_locations
tools.title: List pickup locations
tools.description: List pickup points near one address for a carrier (for pickup delivery types). MyParcel API: GET /pickup_locations.

platform.description: myparcel for NL, belgie for BE.

carrier.description: Carrier name, for example postnl or bpost.

tools.name: myparcel_list_webhook_subscriptions
tools.title: List webhook subscriptions
tools.description: List the webhook subscriptions on the account (the URLs MyParcel calls on shipment events). MyParcel API: GET /webhook_subscriptions.

tools.name: myparcel_create_shipments
tools.title: Create shipments
tools.description: Create one or more shipments. This creates real, billable shipments and labels on the account. Returns the new shipment ids in the same order as sent. MyParcel API: POST /shipments.

reference_identifier.description: Your own reference for this shipment.

carrier.description: Carrier id from the MyParcel API (1 = PostNL in the docs example).

cc.description: ISO country code, e.g. NL or BE.

package_type.description: 1 = package, 2 = mailbox package, 3 = letter, 4 = digital stamp.

delivery_type.description: Delivery type id (see the delivery options docs).

options.description: Shipment options, as in the MyParcel options object. Extra keys pass through.

shipments.description: Shipments to create; each needs a recipient and options.

tools.name: myparcel_delete_shipments
tools.title: Delete shipments
tools.description: Delete one or more shipments by id. A shipment that has already been handed to the carrier may not be deletable. MyParcel API: DELETE /shipments/{ids}.

ids.description: Shipment ids from myparcel_list_shipments or myparcel_create_shipments.

prompts.title: Get started with MyParcel
prompts.description: What you can do with MyParcel here, with example requests to try.
